jobs.description:
Passionate about recruitment, market insights and data-driven decision-making? Would you enjoy helping professionals take the next step in their careers through our MBA programmes? Let's meet!MBA RECRUITMENT ADVISOR  (Recruitment & Data Specialist)
 

Vlerick Business School is an innovative, top-ranked and sustainable international business school in the heart of Europe. Our purpose is to 
transform people for a better world! We want being at Vlerick to be a transformative experience where you discover the knowledge, mindset and confidence you need to take your next leap – and become the entrepreneurial leader our world needs.
 

As part of our close-knit team, you’ll bring our strategy and purpose to life. Are you excited to join our 
MBA team as an 
MBA Recruitment Advisor? Here’s what you need to know! 
  
 

Your mission  
 

MBA recruitment (60%)
 
 

• Build relationships with prospective MBA candidates. 

• Guide candidates through the recruitment journey. 

• Generate, nurture and qualify leads. 

• Support admissions and recruitment events. 

• Identify opportunities for more targeted outreach and business development. 

• Work closely with Marketing to improve pipeline generation and conversion.  

Market and employer insights (20%)
 
 

• Engage with employers, recruiters and alumni. 

• Track graduate career outcomes and labour market trends. 

• Identify employer needs and emerging talent demands. 

• Translate market insights into stronger recruitment strategies and candidate value propositions. 

• Support career initiatives and networking events.  

Process and interpret data (20%)
 
 

• Analyse CRM and recruitment funnel data. 

• Build dashboards and reports. 

• Identify bottlenecks and opportunities. 

• Support forecasting and performance tracking. 

• Leverage AI and digital tools to improve insight generation and efficiency. 

You
 
 

• Have hands-on experience 
analysing CRM or 
funnel data and building reports or dashboards (eg in Excel, Power BI or Tableau) that lead to 
concrete recommendations. 

• Use 
GenAI tools in a practical and responsible way for analysis, reporting and content. 

• Are able to hold credible 
advisory conversations with experienced professionals in an international environment and guide them towards a decision. 

• Can turn data into clear stories for prospects, employers and internal stakeholders. 

• Communicate fluently in 
English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage. 

• Are organised, proactive and comfortable working towards 
conversion targets. 

• Ideally bring experience in recruitment, admissions, sales, business development, consulting or customer success. 

• Experience setting up or managing a CRM or marketing automation platform is a plus. 

• Knowledge of the business school market or graduate labour markets is a plus.  

Take the leap!
 

If you think you meet these criteria, please apply with your resume and motivation letter on our website. Happy to give you more information on the job content: mariaana.pedronunes@vlerick.com and/or the selection process and working at Vlerick: charlotte.mahieu@vlerick.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Brand Manager LU / PRINCE (Business & Portfolio) BNL
jobs.description:
The Senior Brand Manager is responsible for: market share growth, net revenue and margin performance, brand equity metrics, successful innovation rate, and distribution and in-store execution quality.
 

What Extra Ingredients You Will Bring
 
 

• Strategic Thinking & Execution — Solid strategic thinking with strong execution skills: able to move seamlessly from business analysis to defining what to do with it, identifying the key actions, and translating data into clear next steps. 

• Communication & Influence — Able to structure recommendations so that stakeholders quickly understand the context, the rationale, and the step needed — whether a decision or a request for support. 

• Rigour & Attention to Detail — A natural reflex to cross-check key numbers, spot inconsistencies across documents, and ensure overall accuracy before sharing. 

• Consumer-Centric Mindset — Deep understanding of consumer needs; uses insight to shape brand direction and portfolio decisions. 

• Brand Building & Creativity — Passion for brand building with strong creative judgement and storytelling ability. 

• Financial Acumen — Data-driven decision-making through strong analytical skills and solid P&L management expertise. 

• People Leadership — Strong people management skills; experience developing talent and working in a matrix organisation. 

• Growth Mindset — Autonomy, resilience, and ability to stay current with new developments including AI, digital commerce, and emerging marketing trends.  

Education, Certifications & Requirements
 
 

• Education: Master's degree, preferably in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Experience: Minimum 7 years of FMCG brand marketing experience, with proven expertise in brand building, portfolio strategy, and new product development. 

• Brand & Portfolio: Proven track record in brand and portfolio strategy, pricing, and innovation development; experience defining brand growth models and translating long-term strategy into concrete short-term interventions. 

• Market Knowledge: Local Benelux market knowledge and experience preferred; experience managing localised brands with high autonomy preferred. 

• Languages: Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.  

What We Offer
 

At Mondelēz International, you will join a company that genuinely believes snacking can make life a little sweeter — for our consumers, our teams, and the world. We offer:
 
 

• A dynamic, international work environment with iconic global brands 

• Real ownership and accountability from day one 

• A collaborative, people-first culture that celebrates curiosity and learning 

• Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including company car 

• Opportunities for regional and global career growth within Mondelēz 

• Flexible working arrangements and a focus on wellbeing

Our customer was established in 1968 and is a part of a big Automotive Corporation in Japan.  The Brussels office is the headquarters of 8 branches in France, Germany, Poland, Czech, Turkey, Italy and Hungary. 

They are urgently looking for a Business Developer E-Mobility Supply Chain, with experience in Purchase, and in automotive sector. 

This position involves real trading activities and business transactions with partners across Asia (including Japan). They are looking for a dynamic Business Developer who can accelerate this process, drive growth, and coordinate projects effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Business Development & Supply Chain
• Build and strengthen relationships with Asian automotive suppliers.
• Manage commercial activities, customer communication, logistics, and cost calculations.
• Identify and onboard new manufacturing partners.
• Support procurement activities, including supplier evaluation, negotiations, and QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) management.
• Electrification & Market Development
• Develop new business opportunities for battery-related materials and EV components.
• Conduct market research and identify emerging technologies and innovative companies.
• Explore strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.
• Strategy & Market Intelligence
• Monitor market and competitor developments.
• Support business growth strategies and market-entry initiatives.
• Collaborate with international teams to align regional and global objectives.

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree (Master's is a plus).
• Fluent in English.
• Experience in procurement, purchasing, sales, or business development IN the Automotive sector
• Familiarity with Genchi Genbutsu and Kaizen principles is a plus.
• Technical or engineering background preferred, or a strong interest in business development.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills in an international environment.
• Proficient in MS Office and other business software.
• Your Competencies
• Customer-oriented, positive, and proactive mindset.
• Strong analytical and business acumen.
• Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Fast learner with a growth mindset.
• Flexible and comfortable working across cultures.
• Team player who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.

jobs.occupation: Senior Test Manager - AI-Assisted Testing - Brussels
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, BelgiumDuration: 12 months, renewableWorking arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site after onboarding.
About the company
Our client is a leading Belgian company operating in the financial services sector, offering a wide range of solutions and services.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation, the company is looking for a Senior Test Manager to lead and coordinate testing activities within its Application team.
About the role
You will coordinate testing activities and guide a team of Test Analysts, ensuring quality, efficiency and successful project delivery.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating testing activities across different projects.
• Defining and overseeing test strategies, plans and execution.
• Working closely with Business Analysts, IT teams and other stakeholders.
• Managing priorities, resources, deadlines and testing risks.
• Following up on test execution, defects and delivery progress.
• Remaining hands-on and supporting the team beyond reporting and coordination.
• Promoting the use of AI to improve test planning, test case generation and overall testing efficiency.
• Guiding team members in the effective use of AI and sharing your expertise across the team.
The ideal candidate
• Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or in a similar role.
• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools and best practices.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong delivery mindset and ability to manage challenging deadlines.
• Hands-on approach, with the ability to get involved in operational testing activities.
• Mandatory: Proven hands-on experience using AI in real testing activities and projects.
• Ability to translate AI knowledge into practical testing approaches and coach team members.
• ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or higher) is mandatory.
• Good command of English and at least one Belgian national language (French or Dutch); trilingualism is a strong advantage.
Experience in test automation is a plus, but practical AI experience is the priority.

A growing company that packages and stores frozen and chilled food products to order for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where collaboration and job satisfaction are key.

In this role, you will be responsible for carefully packing various food products in a cool working environment of 5 to 10°C. You can choose between day shifts from 7.45 am to 3.30 pm or afternoon shifts from 3.45 pm to 11.30 pm.

The right products are packaged correctly, with quality always being the top priority

• 
A flexible attitude comes in very handy

 
•

jobs.description:
Communication & Campaign Leadership
 
 

• Lead integrated marketing campaigns across all touchpoints — digital and social, TV, OOH, and in-store activation. 

• Brief, steer, and manage creative agencies (strategic and activation) and media agencies to deliver outstanding work. 

• Develop and execute best-in-class annual communication plans aligned to brand strategy. 

• Track and continuously optimise campaign performance through ROI analysis and brand health KPIs (awareness, consideration, penetration).  

Brand Positioning & Equity
 
 

• Define, strengthen, and evolve the long-term brand positioning for Côte d'Or in BNX in close collaboration with the European Marketing Team. 

• Develop and safeguard the brand equity framework and visual identity guidelines. 

• Ensure consistent brand expression and consumer experience across all touchpoints.  

Media Strategy
 
 

• Own the development and execution of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Optimise media mix and budget allocation for maximum reach, impact, and efficiency. 

• Build strong, collaborative relationships with media agency partners and stay ahead of emerging media trends.  

Consumer & Category Insights
 
 

• Monitor category dynamics and brand performance using market data and consumer research. 

• Identify emerging consumer needs and translate insights into actionable brand and communication initiatives. 

• Partner with the insights team to build a deep understanding of the BNX chocolate consumer.  

P&L Ownership & Financial Management
 
 

• Own the brand P&L, including forecasting and marketing budget management. 

• Drive net revenue growth and margin performance within your area of responsibility. 

• Work closely with finance to track investment efficiency and ensure delivery against business targets.  

People Leadership
 
 

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of 2 direct reports, supporting their professional growth and performance. 

• Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture built on trust, curiosity, and ambition.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 
 

• Partner closely with category management, shopper marketing, sales, consumer insights, finance, supply chain, and legal teams across BNX. 

• Collaborate with the European marketing organisation to co-develop, adapt, and localise regional campaigns for the BNX market. 

• Act as a key contributor to the broader Benelux brand and marketing community.  

What You Bring
 
 

• Master's degree, preferably in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Minimum 7 years of FMCG brand marketing experience. Experience managing local brands preferred. 

• Proven track record in communication strategy, campaign development, and agency management. 

• Experience in brand positioning, equity development, and creative briefing. 

• Strong command of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Experience leading and developing a team. 

• Benelux market knowledge is a strong plus. 

• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.
